mainEntity.name: What does "authorised Karndean retailer" actually mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: Karndean only supplies its flooring through retailers that meet its training, display, and after-sales standards. Authorised retailers like Oztop receive genuine product through Karndean's Australian distribution, get product training direct from the brand, and can register your installation for full warranty cover. Buying from a non-authorised seller — including most online and overseas channels — usually voids the manufacturer warranty.

mainEntity.name: Can I come into the showroom to see Karndean before buying?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our Slacks Creek showroom has full-plank LooseLay Longboard displays for all twenty in-stock colours. No appointment needed during normal trading hours (Mon–Fri 9am–5pm, Sat 9am–4pm). If you'd like a dedicated consultation with a product specialist, call 07 3416 6458 to book a 30-minute slot.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get a Karndean quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: For 90% of enquiries we send a written quote the same business day. Send us your room measurements (a rough sketch is fine) and your preferred LooseLay Longboard colour, and we'll come back with a complete number covering supply, underlay, trim, removal of existing flooring, and installation by our licensed crew.

mainEntity.name: Why shouldn't I just buy Karndean from a big-box hardware store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most large hardware retailers don't carry Karndean's premium ranges and aren't part of Karndean's authorised retailer network. Specialist flooring retailers like Oztop carry the actual range, hold real stock you can see installed, and have crews trained on Karndean's specific subfloor and trim requirements. The installation difference is what protects the warranty.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between Karndean and other vinyl or hybrid options?

acceptedAnswer.text: It comes down to budget, traffic, and what you want the floor to look like. Karndean LooseLay Longboard sits at the premium end of the vinyl plank category — best visuals, longest board length, easiest to lift and replace a damaged plank. For higher-traffic or budget-driven jobs, Oztop's SPC and hybrid range and engineered timber options might suit better. Bring your scenario to the showroom and we'll walk you through real samples of each.
